domain: Jeju Island as a 2-3 night option (Oct 17-25, 2026)

verdict.summary: Jeju is optional, not essential, for this 8-night first trip. Its best autumn assets (silver-grass oreum, volcanic coast, haenyeo culture, tangerine harvest) are distinctive, but it will NOT deliver peak foliage (Hallasan peak forecast Nov 6, 2026) and it costs two domestic flights plus a car or taxi tours. The mainland (Seoul + Gyeongju + Busan, or Seoul + Gangwon/Seoraksan) matches the travelers' Japan favourites more directly: Gyeongju ~ Kamakura (temple town, history), Busan Haeundae Blueline beach train ~ Enoden, Seoul ~ Shibuya, Busan/Dongnae/Gangwon hot springs or a hanok stay ~ Izu ryokan, Busan raw-fish/omakase ~ sushi omakase, and Seoraksan peaks ~Oct 20.
when_jeju_is_worth_it: They value dramatic nature/coast and walking (Olle trails, oreum, Seongsan, Udo) over a third city, and are happy to drive (US licence + physical IDP) or pay ~KRW 160,000-200,000/day for a taxi tour.

They can schedule it Oct 22-24 (after the National Sports Festival week Oct 16-22 eases flight/hotel/car pressure) and fly in from Busan (PUS-CJU ~1 h) and out to Gimpo on Sat Oct 24 or early Sun Oct 25.
They want one splurge 'ryokan' night at Podo Hotel (Itami Jun design, natural aragonite hot-spring water piped to every room) or a Jungmun resort.
when_to_skip: If autumn foliage is the top autumn goal: Seoraksan (peak ~Oct 20) and Naejangsan/Gyeongju/Seoul palaces deliver more color in Oct 17-25 than Jeju.
If they do not want to drive: Jeju buses work only along the coastal corridors; inland oreum/Hallasan/forests need taxis.

If budget is tight: 2 nights on Jeju realistically costs ~KRW 470,000-620,000 per person (≈US$335-445) including flights, car, mid/upscale lodging and admissions, i.e. ~35-45% of the US$1,000 cap for 25% of the nights.
verdict.what_it_displaces: Two Jeju nights would typically replace either (a) Gangwon/Seoraksan foliage (2 nights) or (b) one of Gyeongju or Busan. Recommended if doing Jeju: Seoul 4 nights (Oct 17-20) -> Gyeongju 1 night (Oct 21) -> Busan 1 night (Oct 22? or skip) -> Jeju 2 nights (Oct 22-23) -> fly CJU-GMP Sat Oct 24 -> Seoul/airport-area last night. This drops Gangwon entirely and shortens Busan. Without Jeju the more balanced plan is Seoul 3-4 / Gangwon or Gyeongju 2 / Busan 2-3.
verdict.best_jeju_shape_if_chosen: 2 nights, Thu Oct 22 - Sat Oct 24: Day 1 (arrive from PUS/GMP morning) west: Saebyeol Oreum, Arte Museum, Sanbangsan + Yongmeori, Sanbangsan carbonated hot spring, night at Podo Hotel or Jungmun. Day 2 Yeongsil trail to Witse-oreum (partial color) or Olle 7 + Oedolgae + Jusangjeolli, Seogwipo Maeil Olle market; Seogwipo Chilsimni Festival (Oct 23-25). Day 3 east: Seongsan Ilchulbong sunrise, Udo or Bijarim, haenyeo show/Haenyeo Kitchen, Dongmun market, evening flight to GMP.

places.name: Hallasan Yeongsil Trail (to Witse-oreum)
places.summary: Shortest, most scenic Hallasan route: from Yeongsil rest area (1,280 m) 3.7 km / ~1.5 h one-way up past the Byeongpung-bawi cliffs and Obaek-nahan (500 Arhats) rock spires to the alpine plateau at Witse-oreum shelter (1,700 m). Does not reach the summit crater.
places.why: The single best half-day mountain experience on Jeju; like hiking in Hakone/Izu highlands but with a volcanic alpine plateau and sea views. No reservation needed.
places.autumn_note: 2026 Korea Forest Service forecast: Hallasan foliage peak ~Nov 6. A jeju.com Sept 30, 2026 post said foliage had not begun as of Sept 28 and projected first color ~Oct 31 (another source cited KMA first color Oct 14). Expect early-to-partial color on the Yeongsil cliffs Oct 20-24, not peak. Silver grass and alpine shrubs on the plateau are attractive regardless.
places.time_needed: 4-5 h round trip from upper rest area (add ~40-50 min each way if walking the 2.4 km road from the lower Yeongsil ticket office)
places.hours: No booking. Entry control times vary by season; Sep-Oct trailhead entry cutoff reported as ~14:00 (moved from 15:00), with earlier cutoffs to continue beyond Witse-oreum toward Nambyeok junction. Go before 10:00.
places.closed: Closed in heavy rain/strong wind or snow advisories
places.cost_note: Free entry; upper Yeongsil parking is small and fills early (car park fee ~KRW 1,800 per car historically, unverified 2026). Bus 240 reaches the lower Yeongsil entrance.
places.booking: None required (only Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa summit routes require booking).
places.tips: Descend via Eorimok for a traverse only if you have a taxi arranged. Bring layers: plateau is 8-10°C colder than the coast. Witse-oreum shelter has toilets but no food sales.

places.name: Hallasan Eorimok Trail
places.summary: 4.7 km (~2 h one-way) to Witse-oreum via a steeper forest section then Sajebi-dongsan plateau viewpoint (1,423 m). No reservation.
places.why: Alternative to Yeongsil; good as a one-way traverse (Eorimok up, Yeongsil down) with a taxi.
places.autumn_note: Lower deciduous forest colors later than Yeongsil cliffs; Oct 20-24 likely early color only.
places.tips: Bus 240 from Jeju City stops at Eorimok entrance.

places.name: Hallasan summit via Seongpanak / Gwaneumsa (Baengnokdam crater)
places.summary: The only routes to the 1,947 m summit crater. Seongpanak 9.6 km one-way (gentle, long, forest); Gwaneumsa 8.7 km (steeper, better views; Samgakbong). 8-10 h round trip.
places.why: Korea's highest peak; worth it only for keen hikers. For these travelers it costs a full day for modest foliage; Yeongsil gives more scenery per hour.
places.autumn_note: Upper slopes may show color by Oct 22-24 in a normal year; 2026 forecast peak is Nov 6.
places.hours: Winter-season rules (Oct-Mar) per 2026 guide: trailhead entry by 11:30 (many sources advise starting by ~07:00); Jindallaebat/Samgakbong shelter passage cutoff ~12:30 in some seasons; summit descent by 13:30.
places.booking: Mandatory free reservation at visithalla.jeju.go.kr, opens 09:00 on the first business day of the prior month (October slots opened Sept 1). Caps: Seongpanak 1,000/day, Gwaneumsa 500/day. Foreigners can book with email authentication/passport; QR + passport checked at gate; no transfers. Watch for cancellations (no penalty for cancelling).
places.tips: Late-October weekdays sometimes still have slots or cancellations; check now. Bus 281 serves Seongpanak.

places.name: Saebyeol Oreum
places.summary: Grassy volcanic cone (519 m) whose slopes turn silver with eulalia (eoksae) in October; 20-30 min steep climb to the ridge with views to the sea and Hallasan. Free, public parking at the base.
places.why: Jeju's signature autumn landscape; nothing like it in Japan trip so far. Golden-hour sunset walk.
places.autumn_note: Jeju silver grass peaks mid-Oct to early Nov; Oct 17-24 is prime. Visit after 16:00 for backlit grass at sunset.
places.tips: West slope is steeper; go up one side and down the east route. Windy; no shade. Pair with Arte Museum (10 min) or nearby cafe strip.

places.name: Sangumburi Crater
places.summary: Maar-type crater with a broad silver-grass field around the rim; easy paved walk, ~40 min.
places.why: The easiest, most photogenic silver-grass field; no climbing.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass peak mid-to-late October.
places.tips: On the way between Jeju City and Seongsan; combine with Saryeoni forest road.

places.name: Ttarabi Oreum
places.summary: Called the 'queen of oreum': three craters ringed by silver grass; 1-1.5 h round-trip walk.
places.why: Wilder, less crowded alternative to Saebyeol near Haevichi/Pyoseon.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass peak mid-to-late October.
places.tips: Car essential; no restrooms.

places.name: Yongnuni Oreum
places.summary: Gentle, soft-contoured oreum (15 min to top), reopened July 2023 after rest period; silver grass and Seongsan views.
places.why: Easy add-on on the east loop between Bijarim and Seongsan.
places.autumn_note: Silver grass mid-Oct to early Nov.
places.tips: Stick to the marked path; restoration rules enforced.

places.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak)
places.summary: UNESCO World Natural Heritage tuff cone rising from the sea; ~25-30 min stair climb to a crater rim at 182 m. Iconic sunrise spot. Haenyeo diving demonstrations on the beach below (west side).
places.why: Jeju's must-see; the east-coast fishing villages and haenyeo give a seaside village feel similar to the Kamakura/Enoshima coast vibe.
places.autumn_note: Late-October sunrise ~06:50; the spring/fall schedule opens before dawn.
places.hours: Conflicting 2026 sources: jeju.com (Aug 2026) lists spring/fall 05:00-19:00, summer 04:30-20:00, winter 06:00-18:00; other listings show 04:30-20:00 with last ticket 19:00. Either way it opens before sunrise in late October.
places.closed: First Monday of each month (Nov 2, 2026 next; not within Oct 17-25)
places.tips: Haenyeo show historically 13:30 and 15:00 daily (weather permitting, free) at the beach below the peak's west side; verify on the day. Gwangchigi Beach (1 km) for low-tide sunrise reflections.

places.name: Udo Island
places.summary: Small island of stone-walled fields, white coral-sand Seobin Baeksa beach, Udo peanut ice cream and cliffs; explored by circular bus or rented e-bike/scooter.
places.why: The closest Jeju equivalent of a quaint seaside island day like Enoshima.
places.autumn_note: Mild late-Oct weather is ideal; ferries can be cancelled in high wind/waves.
places.hours: Ferries every ~30 min from Seongsan port; summer first sailing 08:00, last return 18:30; autumn last sailings earlier (check day-of).
places.cost_note: Adult round trip KRW 11,000 (2026, includes ferry, terminal and marine park entry). E-bike/tour bus extra (not verified for 2026).
places.booking: Buy at Seongsan Port terminal; fill boarding forms; passport required.
places.tips: Rental cars are banned from Udo in principle (exceptions: overnight lodging proof, elderly/infants/disabled, some EVs). Go early (08:00-09:00) to beat tour groups.

places.name: Sanbangsan & Yongmeori Coast
places.summary: Bell-shaped lava dome (395 m) with Sanbanggulsa cave temple, and at its foot the Yongmeori 'dragon head' coast: layered sandstone tuff cliffs on a 30-60 min tidal walkway.
places.why: Most dramatic coastal geology on Jeju; feels like Izu's Jogasaki coast. Combine with the carbonated hot spring nearby.
places.autumn_note: Clear autumn air; Yongmeori opens only at suitable tides.
places.hours: Yongmeori 09:00-17:00 (last entry 16:30) BUT opening depends on tide/waves daily; often closed.
places.cost_note: Combined Sanbanggulsa + Yongmeori adult KRW 2,500; Yongmeori alone KRW 2,000
places.booking: Walk-in; check Seogwipo city's daily Yongmeori open notice (or call) that morning
places.tips: Olle Route 10 passes here; Hamel ship exhibit at the entrance.

places.name: Sanbangsan Carbonated Hot Spring
places.summary: Rare carbonated hot spring: gender-separated indoor baths (nude, Japanese-onsen style) plus a swimsuit outdoor pool area and jjimjilbang.
places.why: The best public onsen analog on Jeju; pair with Sanbangsan/Yongmeori.
places.autumn_note: Outdoor pool pleasant in mild late-Oct evenings.
places.cost_note: Indoor KRW 14,000; outdoor KRW 5,000; jjimjilbang KRW 2,000 (ktriptips, updated 2026-05-22)
places.tips: Bring swimsuit for the outdoor section. Dammora Hotel & Resort is ~700 m away.

places.name: Jungmun Daepo Jusangjeolli Cliff
places.summary: Hexagonal basalt columns up to 25 m with waves crashing; short boardwalk.
places.why: Quick, spectacular stop near Jungmun hotels.
places.autumn_note: Best with swell on windy autumn days.
places.tips: Combine with Cheonjeyeon falls and Jungmun hotels; crowded with tour buses mid-day.

places.name: Jeju Olle Route 7 (Oedolgae section)
places.summary: Route 7 runs 17.6 km (5-6 h, medium) from the Jeju Olle Tourist Center in Seogwipo west to Wolpyeong. The first 3-5 km past Oedolgae sea stack, Dombe-nangkol and pine-cliff paths is the classic section.
places.why: Coastal walking with cliffs, sea stacks and village lanes; the best 'Kamakura-to-Enoshima coastal stroll' analog on Jeju.
places.autumn_note: Ideal walking temps (high ~21°C).
places.time_needed: 2-3 h for the scenic first section
places.tips: Walk Seogwipo Olle Market -> Cheonjiyeon -> Saeyeon Bridge -> Oedolgae; take taxi/bus back.

places.name: Cheonjiyeon Falls & Saeyeon Bridge
places.summary: 22 m waterfall in a subtropical gorge, open into the evening; nearby Saeyeon Bridge to Saeseom islet. Venue area for the Seogwipo Chilsimni Festival (Oct 23-25).
places.why: Easy evening stroll from Seogwipo lodging/market.
places.autumn_note: Seogwipo Chilsimni Festival parade/drone show Oct 23-25, 2026 at the Cheonjiyeon parking area.
places.tips: Go after dark when lit.

places.name: Bijarim Forest
places.summary: Natural Monument forest of ~2,800 nutmeg-yew (bija) trees, some 500-800 years old, on red volcanic scoria paths; 1-1.5 h loop.
places.why: Quiet, mossy, sacred-feeling forest walk akin to a Japanese cedar temple approach.
places.autumn_note: Evergreen; atmospheric in any weather (good rain-day plan).
places.tips: Combine with Yongnuni Oreum, Sehwa/Woljeong beaches, Haenyeo Museum.

places.name: Hueree Natural Park (pink muhly + tangerine picking)
places.summary: Garden park running a pink muhly festival through early November, plus walk-in tangerine picking.
places.why: Easy autumn-seasonal photo stop and the simplest way to do tangerine picking.
places.autumn_note: Pink muhly peak mid-to-late October. Tangerines are still greenish in October (fully orange from mid-Nov).
places.cost_note: Entry KRW 13,000 + tangerine picking ~KRW 8,000 (1 kg); online tickets up to 20% cheaper
places.tips: Gimgyul (Hyodon citrus) Museum offers cheaper picking: KRW 1,500 entry + KRW 5,000.

places.name: Camellia Hill
places.summary: Large camellia arboretum; in autumn known for pink muhly and silver grass patches, early camellias (sasanqua) from November.
places.why: Near Podo Hotel/Sanbangsan; pretty garden stroll.
places.autumn_note: Pink muhly mid-late Oct; main camellia festival is mid-Nov to Feb (not during trip).
places.tips: Choose Hueree OR Camellia Hill, not both.

places.name: ARTE MUSEUM Jeju
places.summary: Immersive digital-art museum by d'strict in a converted factory; themed rooms (waves, flowers, garden) plus a tea bar.
places.why: Korea's answer to teamLab; a good rain-day stop near Saebyeol Oreum.
places.autumn_note: Indoor; rain backup.
places.cost_note: Approx. adult KRW 17,000-19,000 (2025-era; official site blocked to fetch, unverified for 2026)
places.tips: If they did teamLab in Tokyo, this is optional.

places.name: Haenyeo's Kitchen (dinner theatre with haenyeo)
places.summary: 2-hour theatre in a converted fish auction house: young actors and a senior haenyeo (in her 90s) tell diver stories, then a buffet/course of freshly harvested seafood around a bulteok-style table. Small groups (~14 seats at Jongdal).
places.why: Direct analog to Japan's ama divers; combines culture and a seafood meal. English site exists.
places.autumn_note: Year-round.
places.hours: Show schedule not published on the site; booking line weekdays 10:00-18:00 KST (+82 70-5224-1828)
places.cost_note: Price not shown on site at fetch time; historically roughly KRW 80,000-100,000+ pp (unverified).
places.booking: Reserve via en.haenyeokitchen.com (locations page) or phone/Kakao; sells out.
places.tips: Coordinates not verified (near Jongdal port, ~10 min north of Seongsan). Free alternative: haenyeo dive show below Seongsan Ilchulbong; Jeju Haenyeo Museum (KRW 1,100, closed Mondays).

places.name: Jeju Haenyeo Museum
places.summary: Museum of the UNESCO-listed haenyeo women-diver culture.
places.why: Context for the haenyeo show; cheap and near Sehwa beach.
places.autumn_note: Indoor.
places.tips: Sehwa 5-day market runs on dates ending in 5 and 0.

places.name: Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market
places.summary: Covered daily market: hairtail, mackerel, tangerines, hallabong, street food (black pork skewers, sashimi boxes).
places.why: Casual food crawl like a Japanese shotengai; good evening base if staying in Seogwipo.
places.autumn_note: New-season tangerines start appearing.
places.tips: Walkable to Cheonjiyeon and Olle 7 start.

places.name: Dongmun Traditional Market & Night Market
places.summary: Jeju's oldest/largest market (since 1945); night market with grilled black pork, abalone, lobster and tangerine snacks.
places.why: Lively evening food scene before/after a CJU flight (15 min from airport).
places.autumn_note: Night market 19:00-24:00 May-Oct; 18:00-24:00 from November.
places.tips: Jeju Folk 5-day Market (near airport) runs on dates ending 2 and 7 - Oct 17 and Oct 22, 2026 qualify.

places.name: Saryeoni Forest Path
places.summary: 15 km cedar and broadleaf forest road; walk any portion from the Bijaebong entrance.
places.why: Cool forest walk, partially deciduous (some autumn color in late Oct/Nov).
places.autumn_note: Mixed forest; some color late Oct to mid-Nov.
places.tips: On the way between Sangumburi and Seongpanak.

lodging.name: Pinx Podo Hotel
lodging.room_for_3: 26 rooms in Korean-style (hansil, ondol floor bedding, rafters, hanji windows, loess walls) and Western rooms; a Korean-style family room can take 3 adults on floor bedding (confirm occupancy when booking).
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined snapshot (Oct 2026 search): KRW 384,758-547,748/night, Oct 8-9 from 419,392; historic packages from 420,000 weekday / 475,000 weekend. Third-adult surcharge likely extra.
lodging.highlights: Itami Jun-designed building inspired by oreum and thatched houses; natural 42°C aragonite deep hot-spring water supplied to every room's bath. The closest thing on Jeju to an Izu ryokan with onsen.
lodging.drawbacks: Expensive (one night ≈ KRW 140,000-185,000 pp); needs a car; rooms book out.

lodging.name: Haevichi Hotel & Resort Jeju
lodging.room_for_3: Hotel rooms allow max 3 adults; Deluxe Plus with 1 double + ondol; resort side has condo units.
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined snapshot: KRW 105,619-297,910; October sample 225,328-227,696 (Superior). Extra-adult fee likely; weekends higher.
lodging.highlights: 5-star, beachfront at Pyoseon, indoor/outdoor pools, spa/sauna; 25 min to Seongsan, close to Ttarabi Oreum and Hueree.

lodging.name: Grand Josun Jeju
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined snapshot: Oct 11-12 from KRW 213,041 (Deluxe) to 620,800 (Premier). 9.2/10.
lodging.highlights: 2 indoor + 2 outdoor pools, sauna; near Jusangjeolli, Cheonjeyeon, Olle route 8.
lodging.drawbacks: Jungmun is a resort enclave with limited local street life.

lodging.name: Parnas Hotel Jeju
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined snapshot: Deluxe Twin Oct KRW 254,061-261,492; Premier 308,898+. 9.4/10. Coordinates approximate (adjacent to Grand Josun).
lodging.highlights: Long infinity pool facing Jungmun beach; spa.

lodging.name: Kensington Resort Seogwipo
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined snapshot: KRW 99,451-140,738 (Oct 8-9 from 99,451, 2-guest search). Value option; coordinates not verified.

lodging.name: Playce Camp Jeju
lodging.room_for_3: No triple; would need 2 rooms (e.g., Double + Loft) or Duplex.
lodging.price_note: Trip.com average from ~US$89/room; 2 rooms ≈ KRW 130,000-250,000. Coordinates approximate.
lodging.highlights: Hip design hotel, bar, cafe, 550 m to Gwangchigi Beach; walk to Seongsan for sunrise; 8.9/10.

lodging.name: Lotte City Hotel Jeju
lodging.price_note: HotelsCombined: Oct from KRW 119,198 (Standard); range to 511,517. Expect Oct 16-22 spikes (National Sports Festival).
lodging.highlights: 10 min to airport, black pork restaurants nearby, airport limousine stop; 8.9/10.

lodging.name: Hanwha Resort Jeju
lodging.room_for_3: Condo units with ondol and beds (confirm unit type).

lodging.name: Hallagung Hotel (thatched-roof Jeju houses)
lodging.room_for_3: Chogajip houses for up to 8 (floor bedding).
lodging.price_note: Only a 2024 'from US$105' price found; 2026 unverified.

food.name: Dombedon
food.why: Classic black-pork grill, sets 59,000 (2 ppl) to 88,000 (3 ppl); 11:00-23:00 daily. Kagoshima kurobuta analog.

food.name: Donsadon
food.why: Famous thick-cut pork grilled on charcoal; ~KRW 25,000-30,000 per serving (2025-era, unverified 2026).

food.name: Geumdonga
food.why: Staff direct-flame grilling, sets/platters KRW 52,000-65,000; 11:00-22:30; near Saebyeol/Arte Museum.

food.name: Myeongjin Jeonbok
food.why: East-loop lunch near Bijarim; abalone stone-pot rice ~KRW 16,000-20,000 (unverified 2026).

food.name: Ujin Haejangguk
food.why: Iconic Jeju breakfast before an early flight.

food.name: Jamae Guksu
food.why: Jeju's signature noodle dish; average bowl KRW 12,000-15,000 (2026).

food.name: Negeori Sikdang
food.why: Seogwipo hairtail specialist; braised whole silver hairtail is the group dish (price unverified 2026).

food.name: Village haenyeo houses (e.g., Seongsan Ilchulbong haenyeo-ui-jip)
food.type: haenyeo-caught seafood: abalone porridge, sea urchin, octopus, conch
food.why: Raw-seafood-by-the-sea experience; the closest Jeju analog to sushi omakase freshness.

transport.frequency: ~112-116 departures/day (Korean Air, Asiana, Jeju Air, Jin Air, T'way/Trinity, Air Seoul, Air Busan, Eastar, Parata)
transport.booking: Airline sites / Kayak / Naver; foreigners can book online with passport name
transport.notes: Kayak (Oct 2026 snapshot) one-way from KRW 37,559, but October round-trips average KRW 116,702-202,551 ('above average'); expect KRW 60,000-120,000 one-way, more during Oct 16-22 (National Sports Festival). Korean Air special fare cancel fee KRW 7,000; Eastar special fares non-refundable.

transport.frequency: Jeju Air only, 2x weekly (Mon & Fri; 7C167 ICN 18:05-19:25, 7C166 CJU 15:55-17:10 ICN), extended only to Oct 24, 2026
transport.notes: Not useful on arrival day (Sat Oct 17). From ICN at 05:15, take AREX all-stop/limousine bus to GMP (~35-60 min) for a morning CJU flight. Korean Air's ICN-CJU transfer flights are only for through-ticketed international passengers (not applicable to a separate Air Premia ticket).

transport.frequency: Many daily (Korean Air, Jin Air, Jeju Air, Air Busan, etc.)
transport.notes: Korean Air shows fares from KRW 49,200 one-way; budget KRW 50,000-90,000. Best way to slot Jeju into a Seoul->Gyeongju->Busan route.

transport.booking: Lotte Rent-a-Car (English site, free membership discounts), SK Rent-a-Car, Jeju local firms via Klook/Trip.com
transport.notes: Foreigners need passport + home licence + PHYSICAL IDP (US AAA IDP, 1949 Geneva) - mandatory; age 21+ with 1 yr licence. Full-coverage CDW strongly recommended (often required for foreigners). New rule from Sept 16, 2026: max 60% discount off posted rates (fewer ultra-cheap deals). Summer 2026 off-season compact KRW 20,000-30,000/day before insurance; realistic late-Oct midsize with full insurance ~KRW 80,000-150,000/day (+ fuel ~KRW 30,000/2 days). Per person ≈ KRW 30,000-55,000/day for 3.

transport.booking: Trazy, Waug, Interpark, Klook (English-speaking drivers available)
transport.notes: ~KRW 164,000-200,000 per car for 8 h, up to 4 people, fuel/parking/driver meal included; admissions and meals extra. ≈ KRW 55,000-67,000 pp for 3. Good no-IDP alternative.

transport.duration: ~50 min to Jungmun, ~75-80 min to Seogwipo
transport.notes: Fare KRW 4,500-5,500. Regular buses KRW 1,150 card / 1,200 cash; 100-series express KRW 2,000-3,000; 2 free transfers within 40 min. Route 101 to Seongsan. Inland oreum, Yeongsil and forests poorly served (bus 240 to Yeongsil/Eorimok; 281 Seongpanak).
Rental cars generally banned on Udo.

events.name: 107th National Sports Festival
events.notes: ~30,000 athletes/officials from 17 provinces; expect tight and pricier flights, hotels and rental cars Oct 16-22. Strong reason to schedule Jeju Oct 22-24 instead of Oct 17-20.

events.name: 65th Tamna Cultural Festival
events.times: Programs daytime and evening; opening/parade times TBA
events.notes: Moved from Tapdong seafront to Citizens' Welfare Town plaza. Folk arts, parade, night theater, market. ~79% local attendees.

events.name: Seogwipo Chilsimni Festival
events.notes: Street parade of 17 districts, drone light show; at Cheonjiyeon Falls parking area.

events.name: World Heritage Festival - Jeju Volcanic Island & Lava Tubes
events.notes: Special access walks in normally closed lava tubes; ends Oct 18, so only relevant if Jeju is first.

events.name: Saeyeon Show (Saeyeon Bridge night show)
events.notes: Fri Oct 23 / Sat Oct 24 fit a late-trip Jeju stay.

tips: Weather (Jeju City normals): October mean high 21.6°C / low 15.7°C, 95 mm rain over ~6.7 days, 173 h sunshine; late October trends cooler and windier. Bring a windbreaker; Hallasan plateau is ~8-10°C colder.
Silver grass (eoksae) on Saebyeol, Sangumburi, Ttarabi and Yongnuni peaks mid-Oct to early Nov - the trip dates are prime.
Tangerine picking is open in October but fruit is still greenish; fully orange orchards from mid-November.
Drive clockwise on a 2-3 day loop: west (Saebyeol, Arte Museum, Sanbangsan/Yongmeori, hot spring) -> south (Jusangjeolli, Olle 7, Seogwipo market) -> east (Seongsan sunrise, Udo, Bijarim, haenyeo).
Without a car: base in Seogwipo (south) and Jeju City; use limousine 600/800 + taxis + one 8-h taxi tour day (~KRW 164,000-200,000 per car).
If arriving from Busan, PUS-CJU is ~1 h; leave Jeju to GMP on Sat Oct 24 evening (or a Sun Oct 25 morning flight, giving ~10 h buffer before the 21:55 ICN departure).

Rough 2-night Jeju cost per person: flights KRW 120,000-220,000 + car/taxi KRW 90,000-150,000 + lodging KRW 140,000-200,000 + admissions/hot spring KRW 40,000-60,000 = KRW 390,000-630,000 (≈US$280-450 at ~KRW 1,400/US$).
warnings: National Sports Festival on Jeju Oct 16-22, 2026 (plus Tamna Cultural Festival Oct 17-21) - flights/hotels/rental cars tighter and pricier that week. Book now if going.
Hallasan foliage will not be at peak during Oct 17-25 (Forest Service forecast peak Nov 6, 2026; 2025 was the latest on record). Do not choose Jeju for foliage.
Hallasan summit routes need a reservation that opened Sept 1 for October; check visithalla.jeju.go.kr for cancellations. Yeongsil/Eorimok need no booking.
Yongmeori Coast frequently closes for tides/waves; Udo ferries cancel in strong wind.
IDP must be a physical booklet obtained in the US before departure (AAA); no IDP = no rental car.
Sept 16, 2026 Jeju rental rule change caps discounts at 60%, so very cheap off-season deals are rarer.
World Heritage Festival lava-tube special access ends Oct 18.
